about: Tiny Little Office short links (src/kit/short.ts, tinier/, docs/crypto/short-links.md). c = AES-256-GCM(key, iv, UTF-8 of the long link) with its 16-byte tag last and no additional data; key, iv, c and o travel as base64url without padding. The service stores c, iv and owner = base64url(SHA-256(the 32 bytes of o)); the public link is <service>/<id>#<key>, the owner's <service>/<id>#<key>.<o>. Fixed keys and IVs are for these vectors only: the site draws them from crypto.getRandomValues. Base64url here is RFC 4648's URL alphabet with '~' for 62 where the RFC has '-' (a hyphen is where a pasted link breaks a line), no padding; '-' is read as 62 too.
